name: No Safeguards for Island Events (and Additional Events too)
description: For masochists. All island events, the game's own included, can happen at any time: new events can replace rescue events and the two opening events, and no population limit or trouble guard applies. Only the villagers an event needs are still required. It applies to whichever island events are on in the game. Anyone can be picked and any event can happen at any time (nursing mothers and fathers, the Golden Child, the Tribal Chief and New Believers' story villagers included), except when a pick would make no sense in the event -- a child's role needs a child, an age change needs a fitting age, a pregnancy needs a villager who can carry -- or the event is about someone the village does not have (no Chief, no event about the Chief; a leader can be anyone). Objects that are not living villagers, such as The Lost Children's totem statues, are never picked, and the guards against crashes and damaged saves stay. Off by default, in Owner's Defaults and in Select All too. **Unverified in play: the effect has not been tested live.**
output_tag: No Safeguards for Island Events (and Additional Events too)
behavior_changes: For the new events (Story / Cheat Upgrades): no 61-villager gate, rescue events and the two opening events may be replaced, no trouble guard and no safeguards; only the villagers each event needs. The game's own events' conditions are lifted by another companion (later). It applies to whichever island events are on in the game.
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte, game file or save is changed: the row is only a name in the installed patches' list ("VVFP Installed Patches.txt") that Story / Cheat Upgrades reads.
The game's own island events, their text and their chances are never changed: it acts on the added events only.
evidence_status: the compiled events' conditions and effects pinned in tests/test_event_content.py; runtime/player confirmation pending
